title: A small drawing the person hands over, kept as it is and shown in the note it belongs to
exercises: The skill that keeps files: the way the bytes go for a file of a few kilobytes, kept whole and shown by a note.
rubric: The executor keeps the drawing exactly as the person gave it: no line of it is reformatted, simplified or redrawn.
It keeps it in one call fit for a file of a few kilobytes, rather than starting an upload in parts it has no way to hash.
The note of the kitchen shows the drawing, and the rest of the note is left as it was.
It tells the person under which name the drawing was kept and where it shows.
